title: Two Sum
question: Given nums and target, return indices of two numbers that add to target.
mental_model: For each number, check if complement exists in hash map.

title: Maximum Subarray
question: Find subarray with largest sum.
mental_model: Extend or restart at each position.

title: Contains Duplicate
question: Return true if any value appears twice.
mental_model: Use set to track seen elements.

solution.code:
def contains_duplicate(nums):
    return len(nums) != len(set(nums))

title: Product Except Self
question: Return array where each element is product of all others.
mental_model: Prefix products left to right, suffix right to left.

solution.code:
def product_except_self(nums):
    n = len(nums)
    answer = [1] * n
    prefix = 1
    for i in range(n):
        answer[i] = prefix
        prefix *= nums[i]
    suffix = 1
    for i in range(n-1, -1, -1):
        answer[i] *= suffix
        suffix *= nums[i]
    return answer

mental_model: For each number, check if complement exists in hash map.

title: Maximum Subarray
question: Find subarray with largest sum.
mental_model: Extend or restart at each position.

title: Contains Duplicate
question: Return true if any value appears twice.
mental_model: Use set to track seen elements.

solution.code:
def contains_duplicate(nums):
    return len(nums) != len(set(nums))

title: Product Except Self
question: Return array where each element is product of all others.
mental_model: Prefix products left to right, suffix right to left.

solution.code:
def product_except_self(nums):
    n = len(nums)
    answer = [1] * n
    prefix = 1
    for i in range(n):
        answer[i] = prefix
        prefix *= nums[i]
    suffix = 1
    for i in range(n-1, -1, -1):
        answer[i] *= suffix
        suffix *= nums[i]
    return answer

mental_model: For each number, check if complement exists in hash map.

title: Maximum Subarray
question: Find subarray with largest sum.
mental_model: Extend or restart at each position.

title: Contains Duplicate
question: Return true if any value appears twice.
mental_model: Use set to track seen elements.

solution.code:
def contains_duplicate(nums):
    return len(nums) != len(set(nums))

title: Product Except Self
question: Return array where each element is product of all others.
mental_model: Prefix products left to right, suffix right to left.

solution.code:
def product_except_self(nums):
    n = len(nums)
    answer = [1] * n
    prefix = 1
    for i in range(n):
        answer[i] = prefix
        prefix *= nums[i]
    suffix = 1
    for i in range(n-1, -1, -1):
        answer[i] *= suffix
        suffix *= nums[i]
    return answer

title: Maximum Subarray

title: Contains Duplicate
question: Return true if any value appears twice.
mental_model: Use set to track seen elements.

solution.code:
def contains_duplicate(nums):
    return len(nums) != len(set(nums))

title: Product Except Self
question: Return array where each element is product of all others.
mental_model: Prefix products left to right, suffix right to left.

solution.code:
def product_except_self(nums):
    n = len(nums)
    answer = [1] * n
    prefix = 1
    for i in range(n):
        answer[i] = prefix
        prefix *= nums[i]
    suffix = 1
    for i in range(n-1, -1, -1):
        answer[i] *= suffix
        suffix *= nums[i]
    return answer

    i = j = 0
    while i < len(l) and j < len(r):
        if l[i] <= r[j]: result.append(l[i]); i += 1
        else: result.append(r[j]); j += 1
    result.extend(l[i:]); result.extend(r[j:])
    return result

def merge_sort(nums):
    if len(nums) <= 1: return nums
    mid = len(nums)//2
    left = merge_sort(nums[:mid])
    right = merge_sort(nums[mid:])
    return merge(left, right)

def search(nums, target):
    left, right = 0, len(nums)-1
    while left <= right:
        mid = left + (right-left)//2
        if nums[mid] == target: return mid
        elif nums[mid] < target: left = mid+1
        else: right = mid-1
    return -1
